shell.disclaimer: Not an official FSSA tool. Estimates only — confirm status and report through FSSA. PDF packets help you prepare; they are not filings.

home.title: HIP proof on your web
home.subtitle: Upload mixed evidence, confirm what was read, track the month toward 80 hours or $580, then download a prep packet.
home.trySampleDesc: Optional for demos. Loads fake Maria evidence — never use real pay stubs here.
home.mariaLoaded: Loaded Maria sample data (~62/80 hrs for Nov 2026). Fake data only.
home.disclaimer: Not an official FSSA tool. We never say you are exempt or will keep coverage.

upload.title: Upload proof
upload.description: Photos are read in memory and not saved on a server. Phones need HTTPS (or localhost) for the live camera.
upload.httpsBlockedBody: You’re on plain HTTP (like http://192.168…). iPhone / Android won’t open the camera there. Use Choose photo (snap in Camera app first), or open an HTTPS tunnel / Vercel URL for Take photo.
upload.allowCamera: Allow camera access when the phone asks
upload.needPhoto: Take or choose a photo first.
upload.timeout: Extract timed out. Try again — free-tier Gemini can be slow.
upload.httpsNeed: Live camera needs HTTPS. Use Choose photo, or open the ngrok/Vercel HTTPS link on your phone.
upload.footer: For live camera: use an HTTPS URL (ngrok / Vercel). For a quick demo on HTTP: take a picture in the Camera app, then Choose photo. Fake demo documents only.

confirm.title: Documents extracted successfully
confirm.description: Review the details below and confirm to continue.
confirm.infoBanner: Please confirm the extracted details are correct. Soft estimate only — not an official FSSA filing.
confirm.saveHint: Saved to this device only. You can delete everything later from Progress.
confirm.noDraft: No draft found. Upload a document first.

dashboard.title: Monthly progress
dashboard.subtitle: Soft estimate toward HIP’s 80 hours or $580 — confirm with FSSA.
dashboard.wrongMonthBody: No totals for {selected}. Evidence is in {months}.
dashboard.atRisk: At risk for {month}: pathway not met yet and only {days} day(s) left. Not an official determination.
dashboard.earningsCleared: Gross pay for this month clears the $580 earnings pathway (estimate).
dashboard.mariaLoaded: Loaded Maria demo (~62/80 hrs for November 2026). Fake data only.
dashboard.pdfDone: Proof packet downloaded. Prep aid only — not an official filing.
dashboard.evidenceDesc: Only confirmed rows count toward totals.
dashboard.noEvidence: No evidence yet. Upload a document or load sample data from Home.
dashboard.deleteHint: Evidence is stored only in this browser. Deleting cannot be undone.
dashboard.disclaimer: Not an official FSSA tool. PDF packets help you prepare to report — they are not filings.
dashboard.pathHours: Estimate: on track via hours path (80+)
dashboard.pathEarnings: Estimate: on track via earnings path ($580+)
dashboard.pathNone: Estimate: pathway not yet met for this month
dashboard.smsDesc: Twilio trial: verified numbers only, and a sample Twilio template (not custom hours text). Soft reminder — not an official notice.
dashboard.smsNeedPhone: Enter a phone number in E.164 format.
dashboard.smsOk: Reminder sent (demo). Check the verified phone.

exempt.title: Exemption check
exempt.description: Based on FSSA’s published list. This app only suggests you might want to check — it never decides exemption or eligibility.
exempt.quizDesc: Answer each question, then see a soft suggestion with official links.
exempt.maybeExempt: Based on your answers, you may be exempt for some months — but only FSSA can confirm. Use their official tools below. This app does not determine exemption.
exempt.maybeNot: Nothing in this short quiz suggested an exemption. You may still qualify under another FSSA category we didn’t cover. Check the official pre-screener / member pages.
exempt.q_caregiver_child: Are you a parent or caregiver of a child age 13 or younger?
exempt.q_caregiver_disability: Do you care for a person with a disability?
exempt.q_pregnant: Are you pregnant, or has it been 12 months or less since a pregnancy ended?
exempt.q_medical: Do you have a serious health condition, disability, or are you in substance-use treatment? (FSSA decides “medically frail.”)
exempt.q_other: Might another FSSA category apply (foster care under 26, Tribe member, veteran with 100% disability, recent incarceration, or SNAP/TANF work rules)?

sms.body: 80 Hours demo: about {hours} hour(s) toward 80 and {days} day(s) left in {month}. Soft estimate only — confirm with FSSA. Not an official notice.
